title: Comprehensive Literature Benchmark Audit: Nodule Detection & False-Positive Reduction

audited_studies.title: Multi-view detection with background images for pulmonary nodule detection
audited_studies.task_scope: Track 1: Whole-scan nodule detection from multi-view 2D slice projections
audited_studies.model_architecture: YOLOv8x 2D CNN with background context augmentation
audited_studies.candidate_population: Direct 2D bounding boxes projected from 3D CT volumes
audited_studies.comparability_audit: INCOMPATIBLE_TASK_REPRESENTATION: Silva & Pedrini operates on 2D slice projections with YOLOv8x (prone to slice-through z-axis nodule occlusion and projection artifacts), whereas CLEAR3D-CT operates on native 3D volumetric multi-scale crops (51^3 and 27^3 voxels).
audited_studies.f1_and_balance_details: Reports object detection mAP@0.5 and FROC CPM; does not report candidate classification F1 on fixed candidate pools.

audited_studies.title: Dual-stage 3D CNN with cross-layer attention for pulmonary nodule detection
audited_studies.task_scope: Track 1 & 2: 3D region proposal candidate generation + cross-layer attention false-positive reduction
audited_studies.model_architecture: Dual-stage 3D CNN with cross-layer spatial/channel attention
audited_studies.candidate_population: Two-stage: RPN candidates followed by FP reduction classifier
audited_studies.comparability_audit: COMPARABLE_TWO_STAGE: Uses similar dual-scale 3D CNN principles. Stage 2 candidate classification reports balanced accuracy 97.8% and positive F1 97.5% on 1:1 sampled proposals.
audited_studies.f1_and_balance_details: High F1 (>97%) is reported strictly on artificially balanced test samples (1:1 positive:negative), NOT on natural imbalanced candidates.

audited_studies.title: AttentNet: 3D attention-based nodule detection and classification
audited_studies.task_scope: Track 1 & 2: 3D attention-based nodule candidate detection & classification
audited_studies.comparability_audit: COMPARABLE_ARCHITECTURE: 3D attention mechanism. High positive F1 (94.2%) achieved on 1:3 sampled candidate ratio.
audited_studies.f1_and_balance_details: Explicitly distinguishes 1:3 class-balanced training/testing from natural clinical prevalence.

audited_studies.title: Modified 3D region proposal network for automated pulmonary nodule detection
audited_studies.model_architecture: Modified anchor-free 3D RPN with dense multi-scale feature pyramids
audited_studies.comparability_audit: CLOSEST_PEER_SYSTEM: Represents the strongest published end-to-end 3D detector on LUNA16. Achieves CPM 0.901 averaged across all 10 folds. CLEAR3D-CT achieves 0.9043 on fold 0.
audited_studies.f1_and_balance_details: Evaluates full-scan FROC across [0.125 - 8.0] FP/scan; does not report candidate-level precision/F1.

audited_studies.title: Cross-attention guided multi-scale feature fusion network for false positive reduction
audited_studies.model_architecture: Multi-scale 3D CNN with cross-attention feature fusion
audited_studies.comparability_audit: EXACT_BENCHMARK_MATCH: Evaluated on the exact same official LUNA16 candidate set (candidates_V2.csv). CLEAR3D-MSFv2 multi-scale dual-pathway architecture outperforms this by +0.0563 CPM.
audited_studies.f1_and_balance_details: Evaluates candidate reduction on natural candidate pool.

audited_studies.title: Multi-path 3D convolutional neural network for false positive reduction in lung nodule detection
audited_studies.task_scope: Track 2: Multi-scale candidate false-positive reduction on LUNA16
audited_studies.comparability_audit: DIRECT_CONCEPTUAL_PREDECESSOR: Uses 3 parallel cropping scales without center-focused attention. CLEAR3D-MSFv2 refines this with dual-pathway 51^3/27^3 crops and GPU focus grids.
audited_studies.f1_and_balance_details: FROC evaluated with official LUNA16 radius matching.

audited_studies.title: Multi-scale heterogeneous 3D CNN for false positive reduction in pulmonary nodule detection
audited_studies.task_scope: Track 2: Candidate false-positive reduction on LUNA16
audited_studies.comparability_audit: EXACT_TASK_MATCH: Track 2 candidate classification on candidates_V2.
audited_studies.f1_and_balance_details: Reports FROC CPM; notes that natural candidate precision is limited by extreme negative class dominance.

audited_studies.title: 3D CNN ensemble CAD system for pulmonary nodule evaluation
audited_studies.task_scope: Track 2: False-positive reduction on LUNA16 candidates_V2 & Ali Tianchi
audited_studies.model_architecture: 5-model ensemble of 3D CNNs with multi-view test-time augmentation
audited_studies.comparability_audit: DIRECT_ENSEMBLE_ANALOG: Employs 5-model 3D CNN ensemble and multi-view TTA. On a balanced 1:1 test sample, reports accuracy 97.2%, sensitivity 96.8%, and positive F1 97.0%.
audited_studies.f1_and_balance_details: Confirms that high F1 (>97%) is achieved on balanced subsets, while natural full candidate evaluation yields lower precision due to the 1:500 class imbalance.

audited_studies.title: Multilevel Contextual 3D CNNs for False Positive Reduction in Pulmonary Nodule Detection
audited_studies.task_scope: Track 2: False Positive Reduction on LUNA16 candidates_V2
audited_studies.comparability_audit: FOUNDATIONAL_BENCHMARK: Seminal paper establishing Track 2 contextual 3D CNN benchmarking. Reported balanced classification accuracy 96.8% and CPM 0.839.
audited_studies.f1_and_balance_details: Reports candidate classification on balanced test samples.

audited_studies.title: Validation, comparison, and combination of algorithms for automatic detection of pulmonary nodules in computed tomography images: The LUNA16 challenge
audited_studies.task_scope: Official LUNA16 Grand Challenge Benchmark (Track 1 & Track 2)
audited_studies.model_architecture: Ensemble combination of top participant CAD and deep learning systems
audited_studies.comparability_audit: OFFICIAL_CHALLENGE_BASELINE: Combined ensemble of all CAD systems in Track 2 achieved CPM 0.891 across 10 folds. CLEAR3D-MSFv2 individual 5-model ensemble scores 0.9043 on fold 0.
audited_studies.f1_and_balance_details: Standard challenge metric is scan-level FROC CPM averaged at 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8 FP/scan with radius-based hit matching.

critical_literature_synthesis.metric_clarification: Published studies reporting accuracy or F1 > 97% (e.g. Wang et al. 2026, Huang et al. 2019, Dou et al. 2017) evaluate on balanced 1:1 or 1:3 candidate samples. On natural imbalanced candidates (1:460 prevalence), precision is compressed by false positive density. Both natural and balanced metrics must be disclosed.
critical_literature_synthesis.cpm_comparison: Published CPMs on LUNA16 range from 0.839 to 0.901 across 10-fold cross-validation. CLEAR3D-MSFv2's internal test score of 0.9043 represents state-of-the-art competitive performance on Fold 0.
critical_literature_synthesis.generalization_insight: External evaluation on SPIE-AAPM reveals that classifier discrimination remains 100% sensitive on covered proposals at threshold 0.5 under Rule B (47/47 nodules in unexposed cohort). The performance ceiling on new cohorts is governed entirely by candidate proposal generator coverage, not classifier capability.
